title: Failure-pattern mining contract (L25)
description: Anti-feature extraction from rejected candidates. See ADR-033.

invariants.name: n_window_default_200
invariants.description: Mining input is last N rejected candidates (default 200).
must: older rejections fall out of window

invariants.name: k_threshold_default_20
invariants.description: Feature value becomes anti-feature when K of N rejections share it. Default K=20 (10%).

invariants.name: anti_feature_ttl_30_days
invariants.description: Anti-features auto-expire after 30 days unless re-evidenced or marked permanent.
must: expired entries removed from YAML on next mining pass

invariants.name: advisory_not_blocking
invariants.description: Anti-features apply a penalty to candidate promotion score, NOT a hard ban.
must: applied as score adjustment, not as filter
candidate with anti-feature MAY still be promoted if other signals are strong

invariants.name: yaml_persistence
must: operator can hand-edit the YAML safely

invariants.name: operator_permanent_flag
invariants.description: Operator-set permanent: true prevents automatic rotation.
must: yaml entry schema includes optional permanent: bool field (default false)
rotation pass skips entries where permanent=true
permanent entries never deleted by automatic mining

invariants.name: mining_cadence_bounded
invariants.description: Mining runs periodically. Default hourly, configurable in [10min, 24h].
must: miner is scheduled by autogrowth_background_ticker, not on critical path

out_of_scope: Adaptive K threshold based on rejection volume (future)
